Evidence: NASA C-MAPSS FD001 represents simulated aircraft turbofans, not operational LM2500 marine gas turbines.
Mitigation: Obtain authorized representative marine turbine data and verify equipment, sensor, operating-regime, and failure-mode mapping.
Validation: Document data provenance, applicability, and engineering approval of the dataset.

Evidence: 75.16% of held-out near-failure predictions overestimated actual RUL.
Mitigation: Investigate calibrated uncertainty intervals, conservative lower bounds, and human-reviewed decision rules.
Validation: Test interval coverage, error direction, missed detections, and false alarms on independent engine histories.

Evidence: No OEM-approved inspection thresholds or maintenance decision rules were established by this project.
Mitigation: Keep analytics advisory-only. Require qualified engineering review and continue following approved OEM maintenance procedures.
Validation: Complete operational hazard assessment, procedure review, and formal authorization before any maintenance integration.

Evidence: The model was validated on 20 held-out engines. Twin-engine prediction results were calculated on training engines.
Mitigation: Preserve engine-level separation, document preprocessing boundaries, and evaluate additional untouched engine populations.
Validation: Audit train/test separation and repeat evaluation across independent datasets.

Evidence: Sensor-based predictions depend on measurement quality; actual marine sensor calibration and reliability were not evaluated.
Mitigation: Implement missing-data checks, range validation, calibration review, and sensor fault detection.
Validation: Test representative missing, noisy, stuck, and out-of-range sensor scenarios.

Evidence: The project does not include a deployed model or longitudinal operational performance monitoring.
Mitigation: Design monitoring for data distributions, prediction quality, uncertainty, and model version changes.
Validation: Establish baseline metrics and test monitoring procedures before deployment.
